note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 9494 Section 4.2 ('Once the Restart Time period ends (including the case in which the Restart Time is zero), the LLGR period is said to have begun and the following procedures MUST be performed: ... The helper router MUST attach the LLGR_STALE community to the stale routes being retained.') after commit 21587224da fixed the prior reconnect-during-entry defect. grStateManager.llgrFamilyActive now checks only that state exists, state.source.connectionID matches source.connectionID, and state.llgrFamilies[fam] is active, so a peer reconnect during an in-flight LLGR entry no longer aborts LLGR_STALE attachment, level-2 marking, or readvertisement on the original connection while stopping cleanly if the family's LLST timer ends or a subsequent DOWN advances the cycle's source (whose restalePreservedLLGR completes every retained connection). New tagged real-RIB tests TestRFC9494ReconnectDuringLLGREntryStillAttachesLLGRStale (positive) and TestRFC9494ReconnectDuringLLGREntryLeavesTheNewConnectionsRouteFresh (negative) prove the retained route of connection 41 reaches stale level 2 with 0xffff0006 while connection 42's refreshed route stays fresh without LLGR_STALE, alongside the existing zero-GR, consecutive-restart, AttachCommunity, and fresh-route proofs.
